problems: Caption says 'Wherever I walk, I leave a tile standing' and 'I tip the first', but no walker appears in any frame. The film opens with the row already standing, and nobody tips the first tile. The 'I' and the cause of the fall are missing.
Caption says 'At bedtime', but every frame is in bright midday light with hard noon shadows. Nothing shows evening or night.
Caption says the day falls 'in the order I walked it', but the film never shows the walk, so a viewer can't compare the order of the fall to anything. It just looks like a long domino run.

Storyboard frame 1 and the 50% frame: a huge dark box with antennae (a TV?) sits right in the chain. Tiles stand against it and fall underneath it (board frames 9–10) without moving it. It is never explained, and it blocks a large part of the picture.
50% frame: tiles stand inside and through a red mushroom, and the falling run passes right through flowers and grass. Nothing in its path reacts.
Board frame 7: brown pieces hang in the air above the chain with nothing to explain them.
Board frames 1, 11 and 13: a dark slab or grey pole fills the foreground and hides the action. In the last four frames the antenna box takes up the lower middle of the overview shot.

75% frame and the last frames: many purple and red tiles are still standing after the orange run beside them has fallen. The fall seems to stop or skip without any visible reason, and the film ends without the whole day having fallen.
The camera swoops low and fast. Board frames 2–8 are mostly tilted close-ups of wood slabs, which makes it hard to follow where the chain goes.
posts.critique: This is a long, fairly nice domino run on the island, but the caption's story (someone walking, bedtime, tipping the first tile, the order of a day) is not in the pictures. The run also clips through mushrooms, flowers and a big unexplained black box that blocks the shot.
